questions.q: Fix: 'Do you know where does he live?'
questions.a: 'Do you know where he lives?' — the embedded wh-question is a noun clause; statement order inside despite the sentence being a question. The single most-tested senior structure.

questions.q: Report: 'What a wonderful performance!' she said.
questions.a: 'She exclaimed that it was a wonderful performance' — the exclamation flattens into a that-clause; 'what a' dissolves into the reporting verb.

questions.q: 'I don't know where ___ .' is she / she is?
questions.a: 'she is' — noun-clause order after 'where'. 'Where is she' is question order, illegal inside 'I don't know…' frames.

questions.q: What common mix-up does this lesson flag about Senior reported speech handles the leftovers?
questions.a: Students keep inversion inside embedded questions ('I don't know where is he') and report exclamations by quoting them — both kill the reported frame.

questions.q: What must you be able to do to master this topic?
questions.a: The student reports exclamations and embedded questions correctly, preserves statement order inside noun-clause questions, and selects reporting verbs by the original's force.
